'''Nahum Orobitg Pérez'''{{family name footnote|lang=Catalan|Orobitg|Pérez}} (born 18 November 1971) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. He competed at the [[1988 Winter Olympics]] and the [[1992 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/or/nahum-orobitg-1.html |title=Nahum Orobitg |access-date=22 March 2018 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161203182024/http://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/or/nahum-orobitg-1.html |archive-date=3 December 2016 |quote=Full name: Nahum Orobitg Pérez}}</ref>
